quarterly_data.signal: Viavi's 10-K: the transaction price allocated to remaining performance obligations was $610.1 million as of June 27, 2026, with 92% expected to be recognized as revenue within the next 12 months. Of its legally binding purchase obligations as of June 27, 2026, $144.7 million related to inventory.
quarterly_data.figure: remaining performance obligations $610.1 million (June 27, 2026), 92% within 12 months; inventory purchase obligations $144.7 million

quarterly_data.signal: Viavi's 10-K names examples of its Network and Service Enablement (NSE) customers: Advanced Micro Devices, America Movil, AT&T, British Telecom Openreach, Ciena, Cisco Systems, Deutsche Telekom, Ericsson, Lumen Technologies, Nokia and Verizon Communications; NSE customers include telecom and datacom service providers and semiconductor and network equipment vendors. A significant portion of Viavi's products and components is sourced from contract manufacturing partners with facilities in China and Thailand.
